"""Tests for Japanese and other multi-width character handling."""

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


def _visual_width(text: str) -> int:
    """Calculate display width of text in a terminal.

    East Asian Wide and Fullwidth characters take 2 columns,
    others take 1 column (for ASCII and common punctuation).
    """
    width = 0
    for char in text:
        code = ord(char)
        # East Asian Wide (W) and Fullwidth (F) characters
        if (0x1100 <= code <= 0x115F or  # Hangul Jamo
            0x2329 <= code <= 0x232A or  # Angle brackets
            0x2E80 <= code <= 0xA4CF or  # CJK
            0xAC00 <= code <= 0xD7A3 or  # Hangul
            0xF900 <= code <= 0xFAFF or  # CJK compatibility
            0xFE10 <= code <= 0xFE19 or  # Vertical forms
            0xFE30 <= code <= 0xFE6F or  # CJK compatibility forms
            0xFF00 <= code <= 0xFFEF):   # Fullwidth forms
            width += 2
        else:
            width += 1
    return width


def _check_columns_align(output: str) -> None:
    """Verify that all '|' separators are vertically aligned."""
    lines = output.split('\n')

    if len(lines) < 2:
        return

    # Find positions of all '|' in the first line
    first_line = lines[0]
    pipe_positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(first_line) if c == '|']

    if not pipe_positions:
        return

    # Check that all subsequent lines have '|' at the same positions
    for line in lines[1:]:
        # Skip the separator line (made of dashes and +)
        if set(line) == {'-', '+'} or set(line) <= {'-', '+', ' '}:
            continue
        for pos in pipe_positions:
            assert pos < len(line), f"Line too short: {line!r}"
            assert line[pos] == '|', f"Character at position {pos} is {line[pos]!r}, expected '|' in line: {line!r}"

def test_japanese_truncation():
    """Truncation with max_width should work with Japanese text."""
    # Japanese text that's longer than max_width
    output = render(
        [["非常に長い日本語のテキスト"]],
        ["text"],
        max_width=10
    )
    lines = output.split('\n')
    # Truncated line should not exceed max_width in display columns
    for line in lines:
        # Remove the header separator line
        if '---' not in line:
            # Extract the content cell (between separators)
            if '|' in line:
                content = line.split('|')[0].rstrip()
                display_width = _visual_width(content)
                assert display_width <= 10, f"Line exceeds max_width: {line!r}, width={display_width}"

import pytest

class TestJapaneseBasicAlignment:
    """Test that columns align properly when cells contain Japanese characters."""

    def test_japanese_filenames_simple(self):
        """Japanese filenames should not cause column misalignment."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024.pdf", 12], ["notes.txt", 3]],
            ["name", "KB"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # All lines should have the same column separator positions
        # Find the positions of the pipes
        pipe_positions_header = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        
        # Check that all data rows have pipes at the same positions
        for line in lines[2:]:  # Skip header and separator
            if line:  # Skip empty lines
                data_pipe_positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
                assert data_pipe_positions == pipe_positions_header, (
                    f"Pipe positions don't match in line: {line!r}\n"
                    f"Expected pipes at: {pipe_positions_header}\n"
                    f"Got pipes at: {data_pipe_positions}"
                )

    def test_japanese_names_different_widths(self):
        """Japanese names with different display widths should align properly."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート_2024.pdf", 12, "2024-11-02"],
                ["notes.txt", 3, "2024-11-20"],
                ["議事録.docx", 48, "2024-10-15"],
            ],
            ["name", "KB", "modified"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Verify that the separator line has the correct structure
        separator_line = lines[1]
        # The separator should have exactly 2 "-+-" separators (3 columns)
        assert separator_line.count("-+-") == 2, f"Separator line incorrect: {separator_line!r}"
        
        # All column separators should align
        pipe_positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        for line in lines[2:]:
            if line:
                data_pipes = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
                assert data_pipes == pipe_positions, f"Misaligned pipes in: {line!r}"

    def test_mixed_width_content_alignment(self):
        """Mix of ASCII and Japanese text should align correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["hello", "こんにちは"], ["世界", "world"]],
            ["col1", "col2"]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Verify pipe positions are consistent
        pipe_pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        for line in lines[2:]:
            if line:
                assert [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"] == pipe_pos

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestJapaneseBasic:
    """Test that columns line up with Japanese characters."""

    def test_simple_japanese(self):
        """Single column with Japanese characters should format correctly."""
        result = render([["レポート"], ["notes"]])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Both lines should have the same visual width
        # レポート is 4 chars × 2 width = 8 columns
        # notes is 5 chars × 1 width = 5 columns
        # max is 8, so both should be padded to 8
        assert lines[0].rstrip() == "レポート"
        assert lines[1].rstrip() == "notes   "

    def test_japanese_with_headers(self):
        """Headers with Japanese should align correctly."""
        result = render([["レポート"], ["notes"]], ["名前"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # 名前 is 2 chars × 2 = 4 columns
        # max width is 8, so it should be padded to 8
        assert len(lines) == 3  # header, separator, data
        assert lines[0].rstrip() == "名前      "
        assert "----" in lines[1]

    def test_mixed_ascii_japanese_columns(self):
        """Multiple columns with mixed ASCII and Japanese."""
        result = render([
            ["レポート_2024.pdf", "12"],
            ["notes.txt", "3"],
        ], ["name", "KB"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify separators align
        # The separator line should have correct number of dashes
        sep_line = lines[1]
        # name is 4 chars = 4 width, レポート_2024.pdf is 11 chars but
        # レポート is 4 chars × 2 = 8, _ is 1, 2024 is 4, . is 1, pdf is 3
        # total = 8 + 1 + 4 + 1 + 3 = 17 width
        # KB is 2 chars = 2 width, 12 is 2 chars = 2 width
        # max(4, 17) = 17, max(2, 2) = 2
        parts = sep_line.split("+")
        assert len(parts) == 3  # Two columns should produce 3 parts when split on +
        # Verify columns align by checking the separator structure
        assert "-" * len(parts[0]) == parts[0]
        assert "-" * len(parts[1]) == parts[1]

    def test_japanese_issue_example(self):
        """Test the exact example from the user's issue."""
        rows = [
            ["レポート_2024.pdf", "12", "2024-11-02"],
            ["notes.txt", "3", "2024-11-20"],
            ["議事録.docx", "48", "2024-10-15"],
        ]
        result = render(rows, ["name", "KB", "modified"])
        lines = result.split("\n")

        # Verify we have the right number of lines (header + separator + 3 data rows)
        assert len(lines) == 5

        # Check that all data lines have the same column separator positions
        # This verifies columns line up
        sep_positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[2]) if c == "|"]
        for line in lines[2:]:
            line_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
            assert line_seps == sep_positions, \
                f"Column separators don't align: {sep_positions} vs {line_seps}"

class TestJapaneseWithMaxWidth:
    """Test max_width parameter with Japanese characters."""

    def test_truncate_japanese(self):
        """Japanese text should truncate at correct display width."""
        # レポート_2024 is 4 + 1 + 4 = 9 display width
        result = render([["レポート_2024"]], max_width=8)
        # Should be truncated to fit in 8 columns with ellipsis
        # 8 - 1 (for ellipsis) = 7 columns max for text
